audit.whatIsWrong: Four stages scored against their own why. whys[0] says Gnar wins the first trade before Hookshot exists, but level 1 was scored Camille; whys[2] says 'she controls level-3 tempo' and whys[5] says Sheen amplifies her Q, but both were scored Gnar; whys[6] says 'too close to call' but was scored Gnar.
audit.why: Hookshot (E, 16/15/14/13/12s) is not available at level 1, so Gnar's ranged autos plus a Boomerang slow genuinely win that stage; from 2 onward her wall-dash knockup into Precision Protocol owns the trades, and Gnar loses the matchup at 47.98%.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Gnar, Camille, Camille, Camille, Camille, Camille, Skill — matching the packet chart and every existing why.

audit.why: Camille spikes at Hookshot online, level 6 (The Hextech Ultimatum, 140/115/90s) and Sheen/Trinity; Gnar's spike is the loaded Rage bar, which spikes[3].when already labels 'Mega up' rather than level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent from both layers: Adaptive Defenses shielding against the damage type she was just hit by, and Hookshot requiring terrain. The page also never told the player that Precision Protocol's bonus damage is true damage, while the itemization line pushes Plated Steelcaps.
audit.why: Adaptive Defenses grants a shield versus the damage type of the attacker on every basic attack on a champion, so a cold Mega burst is partly absorbed. Hookshot pulls her to a wall and knocks up on landing — in open lane it is neither engage nor exit, which is the actionable half of 'don't fight near walls'. True damage means armour stacking is the wrong answer to her Q.
audit.corrected: Shield, wall requirement and true damage now stated in the cooldown block, the do's/don'ts, the interactions report and itemization.

audit.why: The kit file flags The Hextech Ultimatum as channel/interruptible and untargetable, but Riot's own description is a dash to a target plus an anchoring zone — no channel, no untargetability. Per the calibration rule I trusted the description over the derived flags, and the Camille-side mirror reached the same conclusion.
audit.corrected: Nothing written claiming you can cancel or dodge her R; the page's existing 'she walls you into a 1v1' framing is accurate and was left alone.

edits.before: Boomerang + hop kite wins every melee matchup early. Identify how Camille contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Mini autos and a Boomerang slow beat her before Hookshot is leveled — trade hard at 1 and shove the wave into her.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Camille must walk into your range.
edits.after: She kites your Boomerang with Hookshot and reloads Precision Protocol for the true-damage hit — her tempo at 3.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Hookshot's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: If Rage is down when Hookshot lands you are a fragile ranged target with no escape — farm safe and bank the bar instead.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Hookshot's cooldown.
edits.after: Sheen amplifies Precision Protocol's true damage — refuse the duel and hold Rage for fights.

edits.before: - Camille Hookshot: matchup-defining — Her engage/stun. Kite the range. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Camille Hookshot (16s): matchup-defining — a wall-dash knockup she needs terrain for. Kite it, then commit. - Adaptive Defenses shields the damage type you just dealt — force it out first. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Her engage/stun. Kite the range. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Her wall-dash knockup, 16s. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Camille wastes Hookshot — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Hookshot is 16s at rank 1 — that gap is your only free window.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Hookshot needs a wall — in open lane she has no engage and no exit.

edits.before: Track Camille's Hookshot: Her engage/stun. Kite the range. When it is down — Boomerang-W + R her.
edits.after: Hookshot needs a wall and knocks up. Adaptive Defenses shields the damage type you last dealt — bait it.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Stridebreaker  (stick + waveclear), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. Anti-heal (Oblivion Orb / Executioner's) early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Stridebreaker, then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. Anti-heal early for her W heal — and note Precision Protocol's true damage ignores armour.

notes: Level-chart flips are one atomic group across both layers and land on the packet chart, which every existing why already described. I deliberately did NOT use the kit's channel/interruptible and untargetable flags on The Hextech Ultimatum: Riot's description is a dash plus an anchoring zone, the flags look like tooltip-parse misfires, and the Camille-side mirror treated them the same way — so the page still never promises you can cancel or dodge her ult.
